verses.text: Ha winhaj Juan yuninal winhaj Zacarías, ayek' winh t'a tzinan lu'um. Hata' ix yal Dios tas ol yal winh t'a heb' anima. Ha jun tik ujinak ayik 15 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Tiberio yajalil, ayik ayoch winhaj Poncio Pilato gobernadoral t'a Judea, haxo winhaj Herodes ayoch gobernadoral t'a Galilea. Haxo winhaj Felipe yuk'tak winhaj Herodes chi', ayoch gobernadoral t'a Iturea yet' t'a Traconite. Haxo winhaj Lisanias ayoch gobernadoral t'a Abilinia. Haxo heb' winh sat sacerdote, haton winhaj Anás yet' winhaj Caifás.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix schael yich winhaj Juan chi' yek' t'a masanil juntzanh lugar ay t'a slak'anil sti' ha' Jordán. Ix laj yalan winh t'a heb' anima to syak' bautizar sb'a heb', snaan sb'a heb' yik tz'ak'ji lajwok smul heb'.

Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios, ayik yalannakkan yab'ixal winhaj Juan chi' winh icha tik: Ay jun t'a tzinan lu'um, ol yal icha tik: Icha tz'aj sb'o b'e ayik sjawi junok yajal, icha chi' tzeyutej he b'oan he b'eyb'al, yujto ol jawok winh Kajal.
Masanil ch'olkixtak ol laj panhanb'ok. Masanil lum witz yet' lum tzalan ol panhlajok. Haxo juntzanh b'e kumkiltak ol tojolb'ok yet' juntzanh amkiltak tojolxonhej ol ajok.
Ha junjun chonhab' ol ilanok to ay kolnab'il syak' Dios, xchikani.

Ayik ix jawi heb' anima t'a winhaj Juan chi' yik tz'ak'ji bautizar heb' yuj winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ha ex tik, te jelan ex t'a chukal icha nok' chan. ¿Mach ix halan t'ayex tato ol yal he kolan he b'a t'a jun niwan yaelal wan sjawi yuj yowal sk'ol Dios?

Tato tze na he b'a t'a he mul, yowalil wach' tzeyutej he b'eyb'al, yik scheklajeli to yel ix he na he b'a. Manh eyal icha tik: Malaj pena, yinhtilonhkan winhaj Abraham, manh xe chiok. Yujto a in tik swal t'ayex, tato snib'ej Dios, syal yoch juntzanh k'een k'een tik yinhtilok winhaj Abraham chi' he k'exulok.

Ha jun niwan yaelal ol jawok, lajan icha junok winh lista yaj yet' sch'akab' t'a yich juntzanh te' awb'en te'. Jantaknhej te' chuklaj sat syak'a', ol laj sch'akel te' winh. Ol syumanb'at te' winh t'a kal k'ak', xchi winhaj Juan chi' t'a heb'.
--¿Tas wach' sko k'ulej jun? xchi heb' t'a winh.
--Ha heb' ay chab'ok skamix, yak'okab' junok heb' t'a heb' malaj yiko'. Ha heb' ay tas swa'a, spukokab' ek' heb' t'a heb' malaj yiko', xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ix k'och pax juntzanh heb' tekumel alkabar yik syak'an bautizar sb'a heb'. Ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a winh: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, ¿tas wach' sko k'ulej? xchi heb'.
--Ayik tze k'ananel stumin heb' anima, manh he k'an jab'okxo t'a yib'anh icha syal ley, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ay pax heb' soldado ix k'anb'an t'a winh: --Ha onhxo pax tik, ¿tas sko k'ulej? xchi heb'. --Manh he xib'tej heb' anima yuj eyesanoch junok tas t'a yib'anh yik tzeyik'ek' junok tas t'a heb'. Schaokab' he k'ool ichataxon he tojol, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ay heb' anima chi' ix naub'tanhani, ix sk'anb'an heb' tato a winhaj Juan chi' haton Cristo.

Palta ix yalan winh t'a heb' smasanil: --Wal yel, a in tik tzex wak' bautizar t'a ha ha', palta ay junxo toto ol jawok. A' ol ak'anoch Yespíritu Dios t'ayex, icha k'ak' ol em t'a eyib'anh. Ichato ol ex ak'jok bautizar yuj. Ha jun chi' ek'to yopisio t'a wichanh. Manh in mojok swak' serwil, wach'chom tonhej tzin tij sch'anhal xanhab'.

Ha jun chi' lajan icha junok winh schayej strigo, tz'el smatz'il t'a skal. Slajwi schayan ixim, syak'ankanem ixim t'a yol yet'tal. Haxo smatz'il ixim tz'elkani, slanhkanb'at winh t'a yib'anh jun k'ak' malaj b'ak'inh stupi, xchi winhaj Juan chi'.
Tzijtumto juntzanhxo k'ayb'ub'al icha juntzanh tik ix yalel winh t'a heb' anima chi', ix yalanpax wach' ab'ix winh t'a heb'.
Ha winh ix kachanpax winhaj Herodes, winh ayoch gobernadoral, yujto ix yik' ix smu' winh skuchan Herodías. Ix skachanpax winh yuj juntzanhxo chukal sk'ulej.
Palta a winhaj Herodes chi' maj sk'anab'ajej winh tas ix alji t'ay. Ay junxo chukal ix sk'ulej winh yujto ix yak'och winhaj Juan chi' winh t'a preso.
Ayik mantzak och winhaj Juan chi' t'a preso, wan yak'an bautizar heb' anima winh, ix yak' pax bautizar Jesús winh. Yakb'an wan slesalwi Jesús, ix jakwi satcha'anh.

Haxo Yespíritu Dios ix emul t'a yib'anh icha nok' paramuch. Ix yab'an yoch jun lolonel t'a satcha'anh icha tik: --Ha ach tik, Wuninal ach, xajanab'il ach wuuj. Tzin tzalaj wal het'ok, xchi jun aw chi'.

Ha Jesús ayxom 30 ab'ilok sk'inal ayik ix syamanoch smunlaji. Tz'alji t'ay to yuninal winhaj José. Haton sb'i smakanhil heb' smam yicham tik: Schab'at t'a winhaj Elí masanto slajwikan k'och t'a winhaj Adán. Winhaj Elí,
